objective: Review the CI fix in the latest commit on claude/nifty-faraday-jinmae (range 02df5d8..HEAD).
scope: CI on 02df5d8 failed 45 tests: git add -u -- .holyagent ':(exclude).holyagent/local' exited 128 'pathspec did not match any file(s) known to git' on a first state commit. The fix in packages/runtime/src/state/tree.ts stageState runs git ls-files first and skips add -u when nothing is tracked; test in packages/runtime/tests/state-branch.test.ts uses a git wrapper on PATH.

criteria.text: Fix: no git call in stageState can receive a pathspec that matches nothing, on first and later state commits, including when only .holyagent/local is tracked
Regressions: staging scope unchanged and the test fails without the fix
